> Provides a small NLU transformer systems workload, but the baseline sits below the stated quality target and needs tuning before score promotion.

| **Field** | **Value** |

| **Model** | micro-bert |
| **Parameters** | 432K |
| **Dataset** | sst2 |
| **Dataset source** | Socher et al. (2013), Stanford Sentiment Treebank binary, 67K train / 872 val; ships in data/sst2/ |
| **Scenario** | single_stream |
| **Maturity** | research |
| **Public status** | systems-only |
| **Provenance** | Devlin et al. 2019 (BERT); bidirectional transformer for NLU |

## How to Run

```bash
# one-time asset preparation
mlperf fetch --workload micro-bert-train --profile max

# benchmark run (writes JSON/HTML/CSV reports + .provd provenance)
mlperf run --workload micro-bert-train --profile max --open-report

# quick smoke pass
mlperf run --workload micro-bert-train --profile min

# research envelope
mlperf run --workload micro-bert-train --profile pro
```

See the [running guide](../../guide/running.qmd) for profile semantics, report handling, and power measurement flags.
